lines.en: I arrive at the porn shop to find Maki groping a poster.
lines.zh: 我到色情用品店的时候，发现 Maki 正在摸一张海报。

lines.en: I would question this sort of behavior for anyone else but it makes complete sense for her.
lines.zh: 换成别人我会觉得这行为有问题，但放在她身上就完全说得通了。

lines.en: I'm just kind of upset that Makoto couldn't be around to see it.
lines.zh: 只是有点遗憾 Makoto 没能亲眼看见。

lines.en: Maki summons me over to grope the poster along with her and, within a matter of minutes, I find myself getting turned on by a large sheet of paper.
lines.zh: Maki 把我叫过去，要我和她一起摸那张海报。不出几分钟，我发现自己居然被一大张纸给弄兴奋了。

lines.en: What sort of person am I becoming?
lines.zh: 我到底变成什么样的人了？

lines.en: Maki summons me over to grope the poster along with her, but I refuse because I am a good boy and my parents would not approve of such behavior.
lines.zh: Maki 把我叫过去，要我和她一起摸那张海报——但我拒绝了，因为我是个乖孩子，我父母不会赞成这种行为。

lines.en: We repeat this for the next ten minutes before Maki gets bored and decides to give me a tour of the bukkake section.
lines.zh: 我们就这么重复了十分钟，直到 Maki 腻了，决定带我参观一趟颜射专区。

lines.en: She does not hesitate in informing me that it is one of her favorite genres and, just when I was beginning to think I couldn't see her as any more of a degenerate, she proves me wrong.
lines.zh: 她毫不犹豫地告诉我那是她最喜欢的类型之一；就在我刚觉得她已经不能再更变态的时候，她证明我错了。

lines.en: I've gotta admit, she really is amazing in one of the most...unusual ways that you can think of someone as amazing.
lines.zh: 不得不承认，她真的很厉害——是以你能想到的最……不寻常的那种方式厉害着。

lines.en: Instead of participating in this immature debauchery, I say goodbye to Maki and go home to play with my toys.
lines.zh: 我没有参与这种幼稚的放浪，而是跟 Maki 道了别，回家玩我的玩具去了。
